data.script: Diego: Welcome to the final! Our team is playing in blue. … Diego: The score is fourteen–fourteen. My arm still hurts! … Diego: The team receives the gold cup and a special prize: pizza for a month! … Oliver: The best part? Kili flew over the court with our flag!

Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving. … Diego: And who is the boy with curly brown hair and a green shirt? … Maya: That is Bruno.
